notes.title: Fixture and Playoff bug fixes
notes.content: [p] [url="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45265503/112e7f0bcd91a8a97d5671856b6cfa5400190b09.jpg"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45265503/e8fdb62e49d75236b682b5f4028dc58dc0a34bba.jpg"][/img][/url]Game Editor fixture calculation bug fix for round robin and double round robin calculations. League 1 and France Division 2 fixture fixes. League table bug fix to stop the regular season standings changing during playoffs. Australian Playoff competition bug fix for game not playing. General fix for the following playoff competitions that could potentially have gone wrong in future seasons. 	North America Playoff 	Championship Promotion Playoff 	League 1 Promotion Playoff  Please Note:-  These bug fixes will be best for new games with the default database only. notes.content:
These competitions are now fixed and will work on New Games.

The France division 3 fix will not apply to any save games or databases created before this build.

notes.content:

notes.title: Fix for massive savegame issue
notes.content:
Build ID : 17159306.  Verify integrity of cache, if your game has not updated to this.

An error could occur with edited databases, that would cause savegames that use the data, to become very large.  If loaded, the savegame would consume a lot of memory and cause the game to slow.    
How exactly the massive savegame was made has not been found.  
How this could have happened has been identified and fixed and it should not happen again.

A fix has been issued that will allow you to reduce the savegame size and fix the database via the editor.
An error box will now appear when trying to load the erroneous save or database.
It will tell you if there is an option to try to fix or not.

The names of the databases in the Steam Workshop, currently with the error are :-

CUSTOM
Betfred Super League
English Leagues Reworked

The authors of these databases will need to get the latest update and load them into the editor to be processed.

notes.content:
Discovered an issue with inactive clubs after testing the workshop database called "CUSTOM".
The "CUSTOM" database would fail at the start.
Inactive clubs as a result of whole competitions being removed using the editor would still try to be processed.
Inactive clubs and clubs that don't belong to a competition are now no longer processed.
The "CUSTOM" database will now run.
